title: Register a custom URL protocol navigation provider
summary: Implements DXP.INavigationProvider as a COM callback in the shim and registers it for a custom URL protocol, so AD hands destinations like npdemo://target?params to the extension, which runs a command in response.
phrasings: handle a custom URL scheme in Altium Designer
react when AD navigates to a link
run a command when a protocol link is opened

commands.name: RegisterProvider
commands.description: Register the shim's navigation provider for a URL protocol and keep the returned handle
commands.params: Protocol=<scheme, default npdemo>|RunCommand=<process id, default WorkspaceManager:NewProject; empty = record only>|RunParams=<default ShowDialog=True>

commands.name: TriggerNavigation
commands.description: Parse and navigate to a destination of the protocol and report whether and how the provider was called
commands.params: Url=<destination, default npdemo://test>|Via=<NavigateTo (default) or Scene for NavigateToScene>|AllowRun (pipe only: let the provider run its command)

commands.name: ProviderStatus
commands.description: Show the registration, the number of calls and the last call, action and error

commands.name: UnregisterProvider
commands.description: Unregister the provider with the stored handle

commands.name: Navigation.Handle
commands.description: Internal: called by the shim's provider for every navigation request; runs the configured command for the registered protocol
